title: Reduce tonal lines
summary: Find the narrow lines (whines, hum harmonics, tones) that run through the clip and cut each one until it no longer stands out from the surrounding material. Static and zero-phase.

params.title: Lines
params.help: auto: detect them. Or a list of {freq_hz, width_hz, depth_db}.

params.title: Minimum prominence
params.help: How far a line must stand above its neighbourhood to be treated.

params.title: Minimum persistence
params.help: Share of the span in which the line must be present.

params.title: Leave standing out by
params.help: 0 = cut until the line matches the surrounding material.

binding_hints.note: auto re-detects the lines on each clip.
